text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having woken up early, I was taking a stroll
through the morning streets—when I spotted
Mr. C.B. and Katsuragi Ace.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't look like it's on this street...
Oh well. Let's go check over there too!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer.
I'm in such a ramen mood right now.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
CB wants to have ramen for breakfast.
I was helping her look for a shop, but we haven't had much luck finding one.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...CB is really particular about flavor, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: “Yeah. The broth was light yet rich with flavor. And for the toppings, it had wakame, spinach, and even clams.”

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm picturing it coating thin noodles as I slurp it down, shluuuuuurp.
Yeah, that's the mood today.
choice_data_list: ...I might be getting an appetite for it too.
...I might be getting hungry for some too.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh! In that case, care to lend a hand?
You know what they say—two heads are better than one, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the three of them split up to search for shops serving morning ramen, but—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Did you find anything on your end?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I see... Darn it, and here I was completely in a ramen mood.
Now that I'm actually looking for one, there isn't any around.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
There's plenty of morning soba and morning udon joints around, though.
...The aroma's really hitting my empty stomach.
choice_data_list: Maybe save the ramen for lunch...?
Should we save ramen for lunch...?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I don't mind if you guys do that.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
My heart is set on morning ramen, though.
Not soba, and definitely not udon.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I can't—lie to myself.
I'm going to search for it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Well, figures. That's just classic C.B. for you.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm with you all the way!
Let's join forces and find the ultimate morning ramen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And... at the end of a long journey.
Finally—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Sniff sniff. ...The smell of broth,
and a subtle scent of seafood ingredients...
...No mistake about it!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Look! There's a sign that says "Morning Ramen Open for Business"!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh...! Seriously...!
We actually did it...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Fufufu. Ramen, ramen, here we go.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ah, so delicious...! With every bite, I feel like all my hard work is paying off!
choice_data_list: The heat of this soup seeps right into your body...
The warmth of this soup just seeps right through you...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yeah! And the umami flavor from the clams is just...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. The spices really hit the spot.
Now that's an eye-opening kind of spicy!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yeah, exactly, a spy—huh?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Why curry?!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh? Because I smelled curry.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
W-Well sure, it's on the menu, but...
Are you really okay with that!? After coming all this way!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Mmm, but now I'm in the mood for curry.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief, that's right.
She was always this kind of person...
choice_data_list: Let's just eat and build up our strength!
We've walked a ton since this morning...
We sure have walked a lot since this morning...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief, that's right.
She was always this kind of person...
choice_data_list: Let's just eat and build up our strength!
We've walked a ton since this morning...
We sure have walked a lot since this morning...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course they are.
After all, they're delicious!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ah, can I have a bite of that one?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sure.
In exchange, give me a bite of your curry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Though it was quite an unexplainable fuss,
the three of us enjoyed breakfast together nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
Turned out to be quite a workout.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright, gotta eat back what I burned!
Excuse me! I'd like a
curry over here, too!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ah, maybe I'll get seconds too then!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I was starving after walking around so much, so I ordered curry—though at the time, I hadn't yet realized something crucial.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I only had a bit of extra time because I woke up early—
today was actually a weekday. ...The deadline for heading
to work and school was fast approaching.
